thread:
Lena: Heads-up — Lotus Insure wants a 3-week POC for their in-house model 'lotus-insure-7b-v2'. They want an FP16->4-bit quant variant, embeddings for claims matching, KMS (BYOK), and SSO. Can SE/Infra confirm technical fit + any blockers?
Oscar: Quick: 7B->4-bit is usually fine but depends on tokenizer and any custom embedding layer. Ask for model.tar, tokenizer.json, and a small tokenizer sample. Also confirm whether they use rotary embeddings or RoPE; conversion logic differs.
Mina: Security/regulatory: they need SOC2 + HIPAA adjacency (insurance claims with PHI). BYOK + SAML OK for Hosted Dedicated. For Private, we can do full KMS in their account. Need signed DPA and BAA.
Harpreet: Perf target? They ask p95 < 220ms for short classification queries (~64 tokens) at 20 qps bursts, steady 5 qps. Also separate embeddings throughput target: ~1000 qps for vector generation (batched).
Ibrahim: Infra note — to meet p95 220ms at bursts, recommend Dedicated with A100-80GB nodes. Suggest baseline 2 nodes, autoscale to 4 for bursts. For high-volume embeddings route to a separate CPU/GPU pool optimized for batching (bigger batch sizes).
Lena: Commercial: they asked about cost delta vs our standard med-7b. Can someone give a ballpark for dedicated + BYOK + 4-bit?
cost-bot: Back-of-envelope: Dedicated baseline (2x A100) + 4-bit ops + KMS proxy => ~$28k/mo committed. Embeddings pool (separate) adds ~$6k/mo. POC trial pricing can be discounted. Final quote depends on token volumes.
Oscar: SE checklist: 1) tokenizer validation (send 50 samples), 2) weight conversion + sanity-run, 3) perf sweep for both textgen & embeddings, 4) SSO/KMS integration test. I can run conversion but need artifacts.
Mina: Also ask them for data residency preference (US/EU) — affects region choice & log retention.
Harpreet: Autoscale sketch for proposal: min_nodes=2, max_nodes=4, target_util=0.65, warm_pool=1, burst_cooldown=90s. Batching: latency-first for textgen max_batch_tokens=2048 max_wait_ms=10; embeddings pool allow larger batches max_batch_tokens=65536 max_wait_ms=50.
Ibrahim: I'll prepare a perf command for textgen and for embeddings:
```
# textgen perf
python perf_runner.py --model lotus-insure-7b-4bit --ctx 128 --batch 1 --steps 200
# embeddings perf
python perf_runner.py --model lotus-insure-7b-emb --ctx 1 --batch 64 --steps 500
```
Expect initial numbers within 48h of artifacts.
Lena: Customer also asked if we can do Private in their AWS account. They prefer Private for production, but want Hosted POC first.
Ibrahim: Private onboarding estimate 2-3 weeks (network & key policy work). Hosted Dedicated POC can start in ~5 business days after assets.
Mina: Security checklist to request: signed DPA/BAA, SAML metadata, KMS ARN & key policy (if BYOK), and a sample of logs they expect forwarded to SIEM. Also ask about log retention (30/90/365).
Lena: I'll send an asset request and schedule a tech sync Fri. Oscar, can you prepare the conversion plan + rough perf SLA matrix?
Oscar: Yep — will prep conversion script and a small acceptance test (sanity classification accuracy check + tokenization report). Will post results here.
infra-bot: Ticket INF-4922 created (Lotus Insure POC). Assigned to Oscar (ml-eng), Ibrahim (infra), Mina (security). Due 2026-04-15.
cost-bot: Draft quote will include: Hosted Dedicated POC (30d trial) + dedicated fleet pricing + optional Private setup fee. I'll follow up once perf numbers in.
Lena: Thanks team — will consolidate and send to Lotus AE. :thumbsup: 
Mina: One more: if tokenizer has custom legal/insurance tokens, token counts per document could spike — call that out in the SOW so price estimates account for higher tokenization.
Lena: Good point. I'll include that note.
